title: Host Accounts Finance Note: Re-Rating Refund on a Stay's Host Service Fee
content:
# Host Fees Accounting — The Re-Rating Refund of One Stay (Host Accounts)

## The amount

A re-rating refund for a stay of a Host Accounts holder, booked with no host-funded guest refund behind it, is the host service fee assessed on the stay, less any host service fee already refunded on it, less the re-rated fee, and never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

The re-rated fee is the stay's host-fee base as assessed multiplied by the re-rated percentage (divided by 100), rounded half up to the cent. The re-rated percentage is the host service fee percentage of the account's tier.

## Which stays are re-rated

The tier start is the date of the move into the tier — the account's latest tier-change date. A stay is re-rated when:

- it was assessed on or after the tier start (its host service fee assessment is dated on or after that date), **and**
- the tier's host service fee percentage is lower than the percentage the stay was assessed at, which is the fee assessed divided by the stay's host-fee base, expressed as a percentage.

Each stay is identified by its host service fee assessment: its stay reference, the fee assessed, its host-fee base and any host service fee refunds already booked against it.

| Assessed on or after the tier start | Tier percentage lower than the percentage assessed | Re-rated |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes — refund worked out as above |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes or no | No |

## Worked refund (hypothetical stay; tier percentage taken as 15.00% for illustration)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Host-fee base as assessed | USD 1800.00 |
| Fee assessed | USD 279.00 (279.00 divided by 1800.00 is 15.50%, higher than 15.00%) |
| Re-rated fee: 1800.00 at 15.00% | USD 270.00 |
| Host service fee already refunded on the stay | USD 0.00 |
| Re-rating refund: 279.00 less 0.00 less 270.00 | **USD 9.00** |

Had USD 3.10 of the fee already been refunded on that stay, the re-rating refund would be 279.00 less 3.10 less 270.00, which is USD 5.90. Had USD 12.00 already been refunded, the result would fall below zero and the refund is USD 0.00.
